source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Obtain and record witness statements.
3. Capture photographs and/or video evidence if possible.
4. Document the sequence of events leading up to the accident.
5. Record the exact time, date, and location of the incident.
6. Write down the names, roles, and contact information of all involved parties.
7. Describe the incident and injuries in detail.
8. Include any immediate response actions taken (first aid, emergency calls, etc.).
9. Note personal protective equipment (PPE) that was or was not being used.
10. Document any contributing factors, such as environmental conditions, faulty equipment, etc.
11. Record any safety violations observed at the time of the incident.
12. Collect and file any relevant documentation, like maintenance records or safety inspection reports.
13. Document whether the accident was preventable and what steps could be taken to prevent it in the future.
14. Include details about reporting the incident to necessary authorities or agencies (
